HeizungPage.heroTitle: Which system is the right one for me?
HeizungPage.intro: The selection of heating systems today is large, so finding the right system for a specific project can be challenging. Object size, costs for systems and associated installations, as well as legal regulations also play an important role.
HeizungPage.airWaterDesc: The most popular of all heat pumps. Used not only as central heating but also as a hot water system. Extracts heat from the outside air for more efficient performance.
HeizungPage.waterWaterDesc: The most efficient of all heat pump systems. Requires two wells (extraction and return) as well as geological analyses and special permits.
HeizungPage.geoDesc: High-efficiency heat pumps. Installation requires deep drilling of 100 to 220m. Absorbs energy through the probe.
HeizungPage.biomassDesc: Wood is a sustainable energy source and relieves the environment. Ideal for older buildings with high flow temperatures and is considered CO2-neutral.
HeizungPage.solarDesc: Solar energy is free and clean. Combining solar technology with heat pumps is a way to greatly reduce heating costs.
HeizungPage.serviceDesc: We fix your problem: burner service (oil and gas), exhaust systems, solar heating systems, underfloor heating, and radiators.

SanitaerPage.intro: Plumbing installations combine a wide world of style, colors, and shapes with technical installations. From simple to highly complex, the plan is not limited to piping systems, but also includes the design of the object and the end-use requirements.
SanitaerPage.sectorsDesc: Our experience extends beyond the private sector to plumbing installations in commercial, industrial, and judicial facilities. As a specialist company, we support you competently in all questions regarding plumbing facilities. We ensure optimal planning and are happy to advise you on furnishing your premises.

KlimaPage.intro: Air conditioners are often confused with ventilation. While some air conditioners do ventilate, this is not always the case. So what exactly is the difference?
KlimaPage.klimaDesc: Refers to cooling or heating as well as the strict control of humidity in a room.
KlimaPage.lueftungDesc: Refers to the continuous circulation of fresh air between the indoors and outdoors.
KlimaPage.detailsText: Certain types of air conditioning systems are designed to introduce fresh outside air to ventilate a room, while other types do not. We also offer well-being through climate solutions tailored to your situation.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.historyText1: Our company was founded in 1974 by Johann Liechti. After initial successes, the company expanded steadily in the following years.
AboutPage.historyText2: Between 1980 and 1990, the company gradually passed to his sons, Ueli and Peter Liechti, who consolidated its success for the next 42 years.
AboutPage.eraTitle: A new era for Gebr. Liechti AG
AboutPage.eraText: In 2022, a new era began for Gebr. Liechti AG when Peter and Ueli Liechti handed the company over to Reinhard and Andrea Peterhans.
AboutPage.eraHighlight: The values, passion, determination, and the name live on.
AboutPage.driveQuote: A sustainable lifestyle is much more than simply reducing our planet's carbon footprint. Living sustainably means taking responsibility for the well-being of our fellow human beings and future generations.
AboutPage.value1: We offer much more than services, we offer solutions; our customers become friends and our projects become partnerships.
AboutPage.value2: We invest in continuous training to guarantee our customers the best professional execution with a high level of quality.
AboutPage.value3: We keep our infrastructure in excellent condition. We guarantee optimal results with an excellent price-performance ratio.
AboutPage.mission1: Provide solutions, advice, and execution for the introduction of innovative and sustainable technologies in the field of building technology, adapted to the client.
AboutPage.mission2: Carry out maintenance work on existing technological building systems to guarantee their durability and continuous efficiency, at reasonable prices.

DatenschutzPage.title: Data Protection Statement
DatenschutzPage.subtitle: (Datenschutzerklärung)
DatenschutzPage.introText: Gebr. Liechti Heizung Sanitär AG takes the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations of Switzerland (nDSG) and this data protection declaration.
DatenschutzPage.controllerText: Responsible for data processing on this website is:
DatenschutzPage.collectionText: We collect personal data (such as name, address, e-mail, telephone number) when you voluntarily provide it to us as part of an inquiry or registration.
DatenschutzPage.sharingTextBold: It is important to declare that we do share customer data which is related by law.
DatenschutzPage.sharingText: Your data will generally not be passed on to third parties unless this is necessary for the execution of the contract, you have consented, or we are legally obliged to do so.
DatenschutzPage.cookiesText: Our website uses cookies to facilitate use and to provide certain functions (such as language selection in the customer portal).
DatenschutzPage.securityText: We use technical and organizational security measures to protect your data managed by us against manipulation or loss.
DatenschutzPage.right1: Information: You have the right to free information about your stored data at any time.
DatenschutzPage.right2: Correction & Deletion: You have the right to have this data corrected or deleted.
DatenschutzPage.right3: Data Portability: You have the right to have data handed over to yourself or a third party.
DatenschutzPage.rightsText: To exercise your rights, you can contact us at any time.
